draw: census: all 95 witnesses of census.json, in order
transcript: Canonical serialization rule: take the proposal artifact exactly as given, serialize it as JSON with sorted keys and no whitespace, persist the exact bytes as proposal_canon.json, then compute hProposal = SHA-256(proposal_canon.json). Re-derive the seed as seed = SHA-256(hProposal + salt) using the engine-provided salt, and verify mechanically that sha256sum proposal_canon.json reproduces hProposal before computing the final seed; the third party can repeat the same two SHA-256 steps from proposal_canon.json bytes plus the same salt to obtain the same seedHex.
